findings: All ten raw CSV hashes, byte counts and row counts match the manifest: 37 downloaded rows = 9 diagnostic + 14 final forecast + 14 historical rows.
Four final scenarios contain only 14 Exact keywords at the USD0.15 modelling input. Four history files contain the same 14 terms and 12 monthly columns.
The US reserve chart reports a fractional forecast while the CSV rounds clicks to zero and retains USD0.01 estimated spend. Missing/non-finite fields do not prove zero demand.
All languages, absent presence controls, estimator strategy, quoted-negative metadata and the network label prevent exact saved-campaign or Audience-exclusion certification.
Four reserve Phrase rows were modelled as Exact variants; the broader library URLs would need destination qualification before any future import.

adverse_alternative.premise_challenged: A weak USD0.15 Exact planner forecast proves the saved campaigns or markets cannot work.
adverse_alternative.credible_alternative: An additional planner-only sensitivity scenario at a different modelling bid or match type could show a materially different volume curve. Different language/presence/strategy settings and Exact narrowing may also change actual eligibility. The current packet did not test those counterfactuals.
adverse_alternative.decision: This uncertainty supports a bounded hold, not a declaration of zero demand, a USD0.50 auction floor, automatic bid increases, market abandonment or reserve imports. Any future paid experiment still needs measurement, economics and exact authority.

limits: Independent verification is local file/hash/identity/arithmetic/interpretation review only. Root native AX observations and action counts were not independently replayed live.
Official-document URLs in the packet were not reopened in this bounded review; no new primary-source verification is claimed.
Monthly ranges are historical demand rather than Exact forecasts; no current auction, conversion, CPA, ROAS, profit or purchase acceptance is established.
No broader source library, canonical files, automation state or live account preservation was reread in this assignment.
No external action is approved by this review.
next_action: Retain the scoped hold; follow the existing supported consent/purchase/economics qualification path. Reconsider only on decision-changing evidence; no new owner question.
